style: Compact friendly chibi cartoon matching approved references. Thick organic navy #102B50 contours, orange #FF5726 accents, cream #FFF1E5 and white #FFFFFF. Transparent background, complete centered composition with clear padding and short tapered navy/orange signature dashes. No backdrop, glow, haze or 3D.

subjects.hunger: der Hunger: child rubbing empty tummy, mouth slightly open, looking longingly at floating bread. No text.
subjects.thirst: der Durst: thirsty child lifting large white/cream drinking glass to mouth, white/cream water drops outlined navy, no blue. No text.

selection: The first ready drafts contained unwanted glows and were rejected. The final compact reference-based version is the preserved ready-original.png. Other original source PNGs are the accepted single generated compositions.
